**Can Taylor request an extension?**

Possibly. It depends on a fact the materials don't supply: whether Taylor Example is a registered participant.

- Section 3 lets an "applicant" request an extension. Section 2 defines an applicant as a registered participant who seeks an extension. Section 1 limits the whole chapter to registered participants. Each step leads back to registration, so Taylor can request an extension only if registered.
